attempts.raw_response: The women’s tournament followed a similar structure, featuring two round-robin groups of five teams. The top three from each group advanced to the final round, while the fourth-place finishers entered a classification bracket to determine ranks seven through ten. In the final round, results carried over from preliminary matches against teams originating from the same initial group were preserved, ensuring fairness and continuity in standings. The top two teams contested for gold, with the third and fourth placing teams battling for bronze. This format aimed to balance competitive integrity with efficient scheduling, allowing all participants meaningful opportunities to showcase their skills across multiple stages of play.
